sources.title: Apodex 1.1: Agent Team Mode + Open FrontierAgent (Aug 2026) - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: Apodex 1.1 mini is a 35B parameter model, released with open weights specifically for local deployment. The comparison Apodex leads with is deliberate: 35B parameters, running in Agent Team mode, landing within a point of a model roughly 28x its size.
